description: This file contains the implementation of theme hooks for the Drupal node module, including theme suggestions, preprocessing functions for nodes, fields, HTML, and blocks, as well as methods for rendering node lists and managing template variables.

classes.name: NodeThemeHooks
classes.description: Class implementing theme hook functions for Drupal's node module, including theme suggestions and preprocessing for nodes, fields, HTML, and blocks.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for node-related templates, including node, node_add_list, node_edit_form, and field base hooks.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsNode
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for nodes based on view mode, bundle, and node ID.

methods.name: preprocessFieldNode
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for node field templates, setting inline display flags.

methods.name: preprocessNode
methods.description: Prepares variables for node templates, including view mode, deprecated variables, URL, page flag, and content array.

methods.name: preprocessNodeAddList
methods.description: Prepares a list of node types for the node add list template, including add links and descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessHtml
methods.description: Adds node type to body classes on node or node preview pages.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block variables, setting attributes for node provider blocks.
